subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers replace the conflicting fork-only fix candidate with a same-repository PR, or wait for the contributor to rebase and make it maintainer-modifiable?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but the only open implementation candidate is outside the target repository, conflicting, and not maintainer-modifiable.

options.title: Replace with upstream fix
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow `openclaw/openclaw` PR, credit the fork work, and close the fork candidate only after the replacement exists.

options.title: Ask for contributor rebase
options.body: Keep waiting on the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it onto current main with maintainer-modifiable settings if possible.

options.title: Leave parked
options.body: Leave the issue paired with the fork PR for now, accepting that the source-reproducible bug remains unresolved.

recommendation.title: Replace with upstream fix
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow `openclaw/openclaw` PR, credit the fork work, and close the fork candidate only after the replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the affected TUI leading-only stripping path and are a strong routing candidate for the UI/TUI shared-boundary decision.
